Patch set 3: LLM-Review +1 (PASS) and Verified +1. Submitted; change 1970 MERGED to main at 2026-08-21 00:35:23.

Two NON-BLOCKING advisories came back on patch set 3 and are NOT fixed here — recording them honestly rather than silently:
1. (concurrency) _extract_stream._fail reads 'captured' via b''.join(captured) while the daemon drainer is still appending to it; the drainer is only joined afterward, in _stream_archive's finally. List append is atomic under the GIL so this cannot corrupt, but on a failure or timeout the error message can be built from a short read and omit the tail of the child's stderr. Cosmetic on the message, not on the bound.
2. (correctness) In _drain, 'kept' is incremented by the full len(chunk) even though only chunk[:cap - kept] is appended, so the retained-bytes counter overshoots and the soft cap trims earlier than the nominal 1 MiB. Same class: it can shorten a captured stderr, nothing else.

Both are error-message fidelity, not correctness of the bound, the drain, the reap, or the redaction. Each amend costs a fresh LLM-Review plus a full CI matrix (~25 min) and would reset both votes on a change already through three cycles, so they are left for a follow-up rather than folded in. Worth a small ticket if anyone wants the stderr tail to be exact.

Local verification before the final push: make lint 0, make typecheck 0, complexity active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0, and all five separate CI gate scripts (check_comment_hygiene, check_raw_git_writes, check_server_manifest, check_verify_gate_parity, check_wall_clock_asserts) clean. Full tests/unit sweep: 11822 passed, 44 skipped, 0 failed in 29m34s.
